title: Rosalind and the Deadline
author: Dominic Vasquez
blurb: Mara Vane, a financial-crimes investigator drowning in clean money, has spent fifteen years following rules that keep getting rewritten. But when every record of a flight vanishes while it's still in the air, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now he must get the truth past three governments and one assassin, and time is already running out.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
